skill.name: recursive-knowledge
skill.description: Build a persistent knowledge graph from large document corpora, then query it with stateful multi-hop traversal and provenance-aware answers.
skill.summary: Build queryable knowledge graphs for large document corpora.
skill.author: Cornjebus

security_audit.summary: The system-reconnaissance hits are false positives caused by knowledge-graph terminology and traversal examples. The Markdown backtick detections are documentation formatting, not automatic command execution. The main residual concern is optional remote LLM processing, which can send document chunks to Anthropic when USE_LLM is enabled.

remediation.suggestion: Document that enabling USE_LLM sends document content to Anthropic, and require explicit user consent before remote extraction.
Warn users to index only reviewed directories, and consider adding exclude patterns for sensitive files.

semantic_findings.title: Optional External LLM Processing of Corpus Content
semantic_findings.description: When USE_LLM is set, scripts/index_corpus.py creates an Anthropic client and sends prompts that include document chunks. This is opt-in, but it can disclose corpus content to an external service.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The prompt builder embeds the document chunk, and call_llm sends that prompt to Anthropic only when USE_LLM is set. This is a privacy risk, not evidence of hidden or automatic exfiltration.

content.value_statement: Large document sets are hard to reason over in one context window. This skill indexes documents into a graph for multi-hop queries with provenance.
actual_capabilities: Indexes .txt, .md, and .json documents into entities, relationships, and source metadata.
Splits large documents into overlapping chunks before extraction.
Builds deterministic entity, relationship, and document identifiers for deduplication.
Queries graph entry points with visited-node and visited-edge state tracking.
Returns answers with confidence, source counts, traversal statistics, and termination reasons.
Can append new documents to an existing graph file.
limitations: Heuristic extraction is basic unless USE_LLM is enabled.
Remote LLM extraction can send document text to Anthropic when explicitly enabled.
The query engine uses simple keyword intent parsing, not full semantic search.
It handles static corpora and does not process real-time streams.

prompt_templates.title: Index a Corpus
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new document folder.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use recursive-knowledge to index my documents folder into a new graph file. Keep verbose progress enabled.

prompt_templates.title: Ask a Provenance Query
prompt_templates.prompt: Use recursive-knowledge to answer this question from my graph. Include confidence, sources, and the stopping reason.

prompt_templates.title: Append New Documents
prompt_templates.scenario: Updating an existing graph with new files.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use recursive-knowledge to add new documents to my existing graph without rebuilding unchanged documents.

prompt_templates.title: Tune Traversal Rules
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced control over search depth and certainty.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use recursive-knowledge with a deeper traversal limit and higher confidence threshold for this cross-document investigation.

output_examples.input: Which teams worked with Project Alpha across these reports?
output_examples.output: A concise answer naming linked teams, the confidence level, source count, and why traversal stopped.

output_examples.input: Are there conflicting claims about the launch date?
output_examples.output: A summary of supporting and contradicting sources, grouped by claim and source document.

output_examples.input: What changed after I added the new policy files?
output_examples.output: A short update describing new entities, new relationships, and affected query paths.

best_practices: Index only reviewed folders that are safe for local processing.
Enable remote LLM extraction only after confirming data handling requirements.
Use higher confidence thresholds for decisions that need stronger evidence.
anti_patterns: Do not use this for small files that fit in the active context.
Do not treat heuristic extraction as a complete entity recognition system.
Do not index broad home directories or folders with unrelated secrets.

faq.question: Does this skill require an external LLM?
faq.answer: No. It uses heuristic extraction by default. External LLM extraction is enabled only with USE_LLM.

faq.question: What file types can it index?
faq.answer: The indexer scans text, Markdown, and JSON files under the selected input path.

faq.question: Can it update an existing graph?
faq.answer: Yes. Append mode loads an existing graph and skips unchanged documents by content hash.

faq.question: How does it avoid endless traversal?
faq.answer: It tracks visited nodes, visited edges, confidence, source counts, and maximum depth.

faq.question: What does the query output include?
faq.answer: It reports an answer, confidence, source count, explored nodes, explored edges, and termination reason.

faq.question: Is it a replacement for semantic search?
faq.answer: No. It provides graph traversal over extracted entities and relationships, with simple keyword query parsing.
